title: Welspun Corp: The Order Book Moved to Arkansas

shorts.title: Why Welspun won't ship pipe to the US from India
Welspun's order book nearly doubled in four months
A moat granted by policy, not owned

beats.say: In May, Welspun Corp's order book was twenty five thousand three hundred and fifty crore rupees. By the twenty fifth of September, it was about forty five thousand crore.
beats.cap: In May, Welspun Corp's order book was ₹25,350 crore. By 25 September, it was about ₹45,000 crore.
cues: In May, Welspun Corp's order book was ₹25,350 crore.
By 25 September, it was about ₹45,000 crore.

beats.say: Nearly all of the increase is for pipe to be made at one plant, in Little Rock, Arkansas.
beats.cap: Nearly all of the increase is for pipe to be made at one plant, in Little Rock, Arkansas.
cues: Nearly all of the increase is for pipe to be made at one plant,
in Little Rock, Arkansas.

beats.say: The company's explanation is not that its pipe is cheaper. It is that its pipe is made in America. This is that story, told only from Welspun's own filings.
beats.cap: The company's explanation is not that its pipe is cheaper. It is that its pipe is made in America. This is that story, told only from Welspun's own filings.

beats.say: Since May, Welspun has disclosed four orders for its American plant. About seven hundred crore rupees of L S A W pipe in May. About nine hundred and sixty crore of coated line pipe in July. Then two much bigger ones.
beats.cap: Since May, Welspun has disclosed four orders for its US plant: about ₹700 crore of LSAW pipe in May, about ₹960 crore of coated line pipe in July. Then two much bigger ones.

about ₹700 crore of LSAW pipe in May,

beats.say: On the twentieth of August came the largest single order in the company's history: about one point eight billion dollars, or seventeen thousand two hundred crore rupees, for delivery in financial years twenty eight and twenty nine.
beats.cap: On 20 August came the largest single order in its history: about USD 1.8 billion (~₹17,200 crore), for delivery in FY28 and FY29.
cues: On 20 August came the largest single order in its history:
about USD 1.8 billion (~₹17,200 crore), for delivery in FY28 and FY29.

beats.say: On the twenty fifth of September, another: four hundred and twelve point five million dollars, about four thousand crore rupees, of H F I W pipe, to be made at the newly upgraded mill in Little Rock. With it, the order book reached a record four point seven billion dollars.
beats.cap: On 25 September, another: USD 412.5 million (~₹4,000 crore) of HFIW pipe, to be made at the newly upgraded mill in Little Rock. With it, the order book reached a record USD 4.7 billion.
cues: On 25 September, another:
USD 412.5 million (~₹4,000 crore) of HFIW pipe,
to be made at the newly upgraded mill in Little Rock.
With it, the order book reached a record USD 4.7 billion.

beats.say: After the August order alone, the U S plant had been handed work worth about two thirds of the whole order book as it stood in May.

beats.say: The focus moat is cost advantage, D three. Not a cheaper mill, but a location. Pipe made inside the U S does not pay the duties that imported pipe pays.

beats.say: But it is a moat granted by policy, not owned. Duties are set by governments, and governments can change them. That exposure is what Moat Score tracks as D eight, and never scores.
